headline: Avengers: Doomsday eyeing Spider-Man box office records
post:
Spider-Man: Brand New Day dominated the box office this summer and became the highest-grossing domestic movie of all time. However, new projections from Box Office Theory report that Avengers: Doomsday is tracking for a massive domestic opening weekend that could potentially out-earn Brand New Day. 🎬

With Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, and the original X-Men appearing in the film, Marvel Studios is setting Doomsday up to best those records. 

Do you think Doomsday will beat Brand New Day at the box office?

headline: Howler: X-Men's Unprecedented New Fan Favorite
post:
Hey X-Men fans! There is a brand new mutant making waves in the comics, and the creative team says the reception is completely groundbreaking. According to Screen Rant, co-creator Gail Simone revealed that the response to the teenage mutant named Howler in Uncanny X-Men is unlike anything she has ever seen before.

Introduced by Simone and Luciano Vecchio, the traumatized young hero escaped captivity and now stays with the Louisiana X-Men, even receiving mentorship from Wolverine. Unlike classic stoic heroes, Howler has sparked an immediately protective emotion from readers. Simone shared that fans send daily emails warning the creators not to hurt him.

While sharing core themes of trauma with Logan, this modern character brings a wonderfully unique emotional depth to the page. Have you picked up the latest issues featuring this new mutant yet?

#XMen #Wolverine #UncannyXMen
original_title: X-Men's New Wolverine Is An Unprecedented Fan Favorite, Creator Confirms

headline: DC Comics hints at next Justice League
post:
Did you know DC has been quietly building a brand-new generation for the Justice League since the 2021 Future State event? This stacked legacy roster includes Jon Kent as Superman, Jace Fox as Batman, and Yara Flor as Wonder Woman.

While classic heroes like Clark Kent and Bruce Wayne still lead mainline titles, recent stories show legacy characters teaming up right beside their mentors. Could a full generational handoff be coming next? 🦸‍♂️

post:

headline: Robert Downey Jr. makes Avengers history
post:
Hey everyone! Robert Downey Jr. has officially hit a major milestone in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. According to Screen Rant, his upcoming role as Doctor Doom now matches Thanos as the "joint most-teased villain of Earth's Mightiest Heroes" across the franchise.

Before stepping into his main antagonist role, RDJ's character has reportedly appeared three times in recent projects. These include the post-credits scene in The Fantastic Four: First Steps, a sequence in Avengers: Endgame Encore, and a shocking appearance in VisionQuest. This build-up matches the exact number of physical pre-Infinity War appearances that Thanos had.

This setup directly addresses common criticisms regarding the Multiverse Saga's newest big bad. With the multiverse heavily explored over the last decade, the foundation for the villain is fully set. What do you think of this massive buildup for Doctor Doom?

#RDJ #DoctorDoom #MCU
original_title: Robert Downey Jr.'s Latest MCU Cameo Makes Avengers History

headline: How Hulk Saved The X-Men
post:
Did you know that the X-Men comic was effectively canceled back in 1970 before getting a second chance in 1975? Writer Len Wein brought in a character he had recently debuted in an Incredible Hulk issue, and Logan joined the team for Giant-Size X-Men #1. It is wild to think how history could have changed without that iconic team-up!

What is your favorite Wolverine comic storyline?

#XMen #Wolverine #IncredibleHulk
original_title: An Incredible Hulk Issue Saved Marvel's X-Men Comic From Cancelation
